create_ClientIOHandler: create a ClientIOHandler instance with a MephistoDB to manage incoming and outgoing messages between backend, router, and clients
launch_channels_ClientIOHandler: launch and register all channels for a LiveTaskRun by calling launch_channels on the ClientIOHandler
send_live_update_ClientIOHandler: send a live data packet to a specific agent using send_live_update with an agent_id and data dictionary
enqueue_agent_details_ClientIOHandler: enqueue agent details to a channel by request_id using enqueue_agent_details with additional data
shutdown_ClientIOHandler: shutdown the ClientIOHandler to close all channels, drain the message queue, and cancel the status ping task
